utility.notes: Chico is confirmed to be within PG&E's electric service territory.

value.name: Pacific Gas & Electric (PG&E)
value.notes: Directly re-verified this session via Pioneer Community Energy's own homepage, which describes its current service area as 'most of the communities in unincorporated Placer and El Dorado counties, the Town of Loomis, and the cities of Auburn, Colfax, Grass Valley, Lincoln, Nevada City, Placerville and Rocklin' -- Chico and Butte County are not included. No CCA currently serves Chico. PG&E is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

permit_url.notes: The fetched page describes the general eTRAKiT online permit portal and gives a solar-application-description example, but did not itemize solar-specific requirements, fees, or timelines.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Chico/Butte County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.
